objective: Implement the local file storage service for the mobile app, including deterministic folder creation, safe persisted file references, and checksum helpers for attachments and bundles.
success_criteria: A local file storage service creates and resolves the expected local folders for audio, attachments, exports, imports, reports, and temp files.
File references can be persisted as relative paths and resolved safely under one storage root.
A deterministic checksum helper exists for attachments and bundles.
The work remains local-only and does not introduce sync or hosted storage behavior.
stop_conditions: The task requires external storage or sync APIs.
The task requires editing database, feature, or docs paths outside the allowed scope.
The implementation would require a third-party hashing or storage package just to satisfy the acceptance criteria.
approval_gates: Adding cloud or shared storage behavior
Expanding scope beyond T2 local file storage
Changing canonical architecture docs instead of implementing within the allowed code paths
notes: Ticket source: docs/implementation-tickets.md T2 Create local file storage service.
